name: com.n0brains/mcp
title: n0brains market intelligence
description: 52-tool MCP server for crypto + tokenized-equity market intelligence: pre-trade vetting (check_trade), actionable signals, positioning and crowding, liquidation maps, support/resistance levels, macro regime, options, sentiment, and a public audited win-rate. Every metric carries its own honesty metadata.

authentication.instructions: Get a free key at https://n0brains.com/signup. Send it as an X-API-Key header, an Authorization: Bearer header, or (for MCP clients that cannot set headers, e.g. claude.ai custom connectors) an ?api_key= URL query parameter. initialize and tools/list work unauthenticated. Free tier covers a subset of tools; the full catalog is on Pro. No-account pay-per-call is available via x402 (USDC on Base): https://api.n0brains.com/.well-known/x402.json
